subject: Privileged access ownership retrospective & SCIM/SAML deliverables for PharmaOne
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, security@pharmaone.com
Date: 2026-05-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Privileged access ownership retrospective & SCIM/SAML deliverables for PharmaOne

Hi team,

PharmaOne's SIG intake turned up a few follow-ups from their pen-testing and SOC 2 reviewer that I want us to get ahead of. Lena asked for a concise owner-of-record roster for privileged roles + a small sample bundle:

- SCIM delta log (last 7 days) showing provisioning/deprovisioning events
- A set of SAML assertion samples for three user sessions (with PII redacted)
- A least-privilege mapping matrix for service accounts + delegated roles (owner + justification)

I drafted a short timeline they can work with: deliver owner roster + minpriv matrix by EOD Tue (2026-05-31), SCIM/SAML samples by Fri (2026-06-04). If we need to compress that window, flag it now.

Attachments: scim_delta_sample.csv (stub), minpriv_matrix_v1.xlsx (template), saml_assertion_samples.txt (example format)

Jordan — can you pull the owner-of-record snapshot and annotate any cross-team exceptions?
Marcus — can you validate the service account mapping and sign off on redaction for SAML samples?

I want to keep this tidy: single Drive folder + single zip delivery so PharmaOne can ingest it into their SIG portal.

Thanks,
Soojin
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference

---
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@pharmaone.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@pharmaone.com
Date: 2026-05-28T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Privileged access ownership retrospective & SCIM/SAML deliverables for PharmaOne

Hi Soojin,

Thanks — this looks good. Quick clarifications so we prepare the reviewer checklist on our side:

1) For the SCIM delta sample: can you include the user_id and event_type columns (create/update/delete) and a short column explaining source (admin console / SCIM sync / API)? We only need three days if a full week is harder.
2) For SAML assertions: we prefer three distinct user sessions that show MFA=True, and one service-account assertion if available. Redact user.email but keep user.id (UUID) — that helps correlate with other logs.
3) The min-priv matrix: are you able to include the last-attestation date and the named approver for each owner-of-record?

Timeline: our reviewer would ideally get the owner roster + min-priv matrix by 2026-06-01 COB. The SCIM/SAML samples can land by 2026-06-05. If you can hit the earlier dates you listed, great; we can accept staggered drop-offs.

We are trying to close out the SIG runbook for your tenant this month; appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Security Assurance Lead
PharmaOne Inc.

---
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@pharmaone.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-29T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Privileged access ownership retrospective & SCIM/SAML deliverables for PharmaOne

Lena — thanks for the clarifications. Quick update from my side:

- Owner-of-record snapshot: exported and annotated. I included owner email, role name, last-attested date, and the short justification field. There are three cross-team exceptions (devops-service-admin, legacy-ops-runner, onboarding-bot) where the owner is a team alias; I flagged each with recommended owners and a short backfill plan.
- SCIM sample: I can produce a 3-day delta with user_id, event_type, source, and timestamp. I will strip any raw emails but keep the UUIDs.
- SAML samples: I can collect three user assertions and a service-account assertion. Marcus — I will send the redaction preview for approval before we deliver.

Delivery plan: I will drop owner roster + min-priv matrix into the shared drive link (folder: /pharmaone-sig-drop) by 2026-06-01 17:00 PDT. SCIM + SAML samples will be staged there by 2026-06-04 EOD.

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeF-pharmadrive-samples

Soojin — tagging you for any scope changes.

Cheers,
Jordan
Security Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@pharmaone.com>
Date: 2026-06-01T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Privileged access ownership retrospective & SCIM/SAML deliverables for PharmaOne

Hi all — quick sign-off and a couple of notes from svc-account side: 

1) I reviewed Jordan's proposed owner assignments for the three exceptions and agree with the replacements. I'll own the follow-up to ensure delegation policies are updated by 2026-06-08.
2) For SAML redaction: we will provide the assertion XML with user.email replaced by user.id:uuid and remove attributes that contain internal hostnames. I validated MFA=True is captured in the AuthnContextClassRef for our IdP.
3) SCIM sample will include source column values (admin, scim-sync, api) and I confirmed there are no raw password fields in the export.

I've attached the minpriv_matrix_v1.xlsx (filled for high-risk service accounts) and a short readme in the Drive explaining redaction rules.

Next steps: Jordan will upload the agreed bundle to the drive by EOD today; Soojin, can you do a final client-facing note to Lena confirming the bundle contents once uploaded?

Thanks — will follow up once delegation policy changes are scheduled.

Marcus Lin
Engineering Lead, Platform Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: minpriv_matrix_v1.xlsx, scim_delta_sample.csv, saml_assertion_samples.txt
